hypotheses.expect: A ticket's chart is never redrafted without being re-charted: sail.py draft refuses while a validate berth already stands for the ticket, and --rechart drafts and charts in one act, refusing unless the validate berth moved.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) a validate berth claiming the ticket in the berth store: draft exits 1, names the berth and --rechart, and leaves the plan's bytes unchanged; (2) a validate berth recorded only in the ticket's chart_claim: draft refuses the same way; (3) with no validate berth standing, draft writes every chart stage as before; (4) --rechart over a standing berth drafts, charts every stage, and exits 0 when a new validate berth now claims the ticket; (5) --rechart whose charting leaves the old validate berth standing exits 1 and says it did not move
hypotheses.piece: D1: draft in sail.py reads the standing validate berth by both spellings and refuses without --rechart; --rechart drafts, charts and checks the berth moved.
